explanation: Zero at every D1 and GO step, and zero everywhere before about trial 85; it only fires at D2 late in the episode (trials 85-97), mostly when the agent chose a2 again right after an a2 choice that led rarely to S1, and the previous trial was rewarded. In that case it is 10 when this a2 reaches S2 commonly (or 8-10 when it reaches S1 rarely again); it is about 5 around trial 90, 1-4 for similar patterns after a1 choices or with weaker history, and 0 elsewhere, including the same pattern before trial 80.
